asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_5 (female grad student, Asian ethnicity, red shorts) is kneeling on dark charcoal-grey rocky terrain, using a magnifying glass to look at a faint trackway.

visual_notes.ichnology: Primitive track morphology: very long, thin toe impressions on the rear feet. The hand prints are small and shallow. Tracks are rendered as depressions in a thin layer of light-grey volcanic ash dusting the dark rock.
visual_notes.ground: Dark charcoal-grey rocky terrain with light-grey ash dusting and small alpine ferns.
